verdict.rationale: Dover is a SaaS applicant tracking system that stores candidate data, so letting customers choose a storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data regions, residency options, or where data is hosted. The docs and probes cover only ATS features, integrations, pricing, and API availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
